items.title: Christian McBride interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: Wynton was like a mentor for all of the young high school students... to have a mentor like that that takes you under their wing

ctx.x: Let’s see. I first met Wynton Marsalis when I was fifteen years old, fourteen years old. He came to Philadelphia to do a workshop with the local Philadelphia high school students. And Wynton was like a mentor for all of the young high school students. However I was probably one of the only ones that had all of his albums and knew every song off of all of those albums. So I tried to impress him by playing a song off of the record. I can’t remember which one it was but I caught him. And from that point on he ©…

became like my big brother. I mean he used to go so far as to call my teachers at school to make sure I was getting good grades. So Wynton was definitely someone that I needed. Wynton is someone that everyone needs in their life, especially when you’re that young you know, to have a mentor like that that takes you under their wing and just set you straight.
